         if not any(sum(K[k][i]==1 for k in z)>1 for i in range(3))]

    fo[i,j,k]=(zi*zi,0 if k==1 else (-2 if k==0 else 2)*zr*zi,

                    (1+X*X if j==1 else 1)*
